title: 12 Best Busan Raw Fish Restaurants (Hoesik)
description: Discover the top Busan raw fish restaurants (Hoesik) for your next seafood adventure. From bustling markets to scenic coastal eateries, find the freshest sashimi and local specialties.

places.name: Jagalchi Ajumma Hoe Center (Jagalchi Market)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Morwui (assorted sashimi platter) with fresh local whitefish like flatfish (광어) or rockfish (우럭)

places.name: Millak Hoe Town (Sajangnim Hoekjib)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Hoe jeongsik (sashimi set meal) featuring a variety of seasonal fish, followed by a savory maeuntang.

places.name: Cheongsapo Suyoung Hoejip
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Seasonal premium assorted sashimi (제철 모듬회) and their grilled eel (장어구이) is also highly recommended.

places.name: Mipo Port Hoe Center (Mipo Ending Hoetjip)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A custom assortment of whatever fish looks freshest that day, often including sea bream (도미) and octopus (낙지).

places.name: Haeundae Geoga Daege & Hoe (거가대게횟집)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A combination set featuring king crab and a premium assorted sashimi platter, ensuring you get the best of both worlds.

places.name: Gijang Crab Market Hoe (Gijang Hoetjip)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Any seasonal whitefish sashimi (e.g., flounder, rockfish) or a simple 'hoe-deopbap' (raw fish rice bowl) for a quick, delicious meal.

places.name: Oryukdo Hoetjip (오륙도횟집)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Oryukdo Special Assorted Sashimi (오륙도 특선 모듬회) which often includes unique local catches.

places.name: Donga Hoetjip (동아횟집)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their signature 'mulhoe' (cold spicy raw fish soup) in summer, or a classic assorted sashimi platter year-round.

places.name: Gomsoeul Hoetjip (곰소횟집)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order The 'Gomsoeul Special Assorted Sashimi' (곰소 스페셜 모듬회) for a generous spread of seasonal fish.

places.name: Donghae Hoetjip (동해횟집)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their seasonal whitefish sashimi (도미회, 광어회) and don't miss the fresh abalone (전복) if available.

places.name: Geumgangsan Hoetjip (금강산횟집)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order Their special assorted platter (특선 모듬회) which often includes a wider variety of less common fish alongside the classics.

places.name: Suyeong Raw Fish Market (Gwangalli Sutbul Hoetjip)
places.whatToOrder: 🍽️ What to order A classic assorted sashimi platter and consider adding some grilled shellfish (조개구이) for a varied experience.
